name: @parallel-consumer/proxy-client-demo
description: The TypeScript demo for Parallel Consumer's language proxy: the same records through kafkajs one at a time, and through this repository's TypeScript client library over a sidecar. JSON allows no comments, so: this is a SEPARATE package from the client library beside it on purpose - the demo is an application that depends on the library, and kafkajs is the demo's dependency and never the library's, because the whole point of the sidecar arm is that a foreign application needs no Kafka client at all. It reaches the library through `file:..`, which npm resolves to a symlink, so the demo consumes the built dist/ a user would install rather than the sources. Entry point is demo/run.sh, never `node` by hand. Copyright (C) 2026 Antony Stubbs and contributors.
